blocks.text: The Splunk outegration is used to send data from Agentic SOC to Splunk, creating a Splunk security incident that can be tracked, assigned, and enriched by your remediation teams working with Splunk.
This article is a step-by-step guide to setting up the Splunk outegration. The process involves setting up authentication, outegration mapping, and defining incident criteria.
Retrieve the required authentication parameters and enter them in the corresponding fields during the Connect step of the outegration setup wizard.

blocks.item: Locate the base URL of your Splunk instance. If you have configured the HTTP Event Collector to listen on a port, you must include the port number. To find the port number, refer to the Splunk documentation.
Create a new HTTP Event Collector token. To learn more, refer to the Splunk documentation.

blocks.text: When the outegration setup is complete, Agentic SOC dispatches incidents to Splunk when certain criteria are met. You can view dispatch runs in the outegration's activity log. To learn more, see Configuring Incident Workflows and Managing Outegrations.
